title: Argentine War of Independence
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Argentine War of Independence", at revision 1375018429, opens: "The Argentine War of Independence was a set of military events from 1810 to 1825 which resulted in the consolidation of Argentina as an independent country from Spanish rule. The historiographical term encompasses battles and military feats such as the Crossing of the Andes. Formal independence was declared in 1816 by the Congress of Tucumán." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q617409, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Argentina's war against Spain for independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
